text: The telescope and nebula are the starting points of many astronomical observations. The telescope is a mechanical device that produces light from a small mirror. The nebula is a cloud of gas and dust that surrounds the stars, and that can be seen only when the telescope is pointed at it. The nebula is the beginning of the cosmic story of stars.
